scores.evidence: M2 "Excludes user traffic"; pilot "if T15 passed"; M2 depends on "ExpressRoute delivered; risk assessment"; T-task order columns (T5→T6→T7→T8→T10→T11)
scores.rationale: Phases run landing zone → network → identity → DB/app → slice → prod replica → pilot → cutover, with each step gated on proof of its predecessor.

scores.evidence: M1: "working end-to-end slice in a cloud pre-production environment... Excludes PHI, prod and ExpressRoute"
scores.rationale: A real end-to-end slice through the pipeline comes first, but it is in preprod with synthetic data rather than a production path, so it is only partial.

scores.evidence: D2 "Revisit if: On-prem is SQL 2022 and the T4 assessment shows no blockers"; decision table with options, reversibility, revisit triggers; assumptions with defaults
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions (single writer, cloud, DB method) are listed up front with defaults, reversibility and flip conditions, and assumptions are explicit.

scores.evidence: T14 hybrid failover spike and T3 dependency inventory in M1; "Moving the DB first would put the whole hospital on cross-WAN queries"; pilot canary before full cutover
scores.rationale: Widest-impact risks (DB single writer, hidden dependencies, network) are de-risked first, with a small pilot before the whole-hospital switch.

scores.evidence: "Security (built in M1, verified in M2)"; T5 policy deny public IPs; risk assessment gate "before any PHI is replicated"; M3 go-live needs no open high findings
scores.rationale: Security has concrete treatment in M1 (policy, Key Vault, synthetic data), M2 (risk assessment, pen test) and M3 and M4 gates (retirement, media sanitisation).

scores.evidence: T13 "Synthetic Monitor booking into ZZTEST every 5 minutes... alert to on-call"; "Observability (M1, extended in M2)"; reconciliation and hypercare in M3
scores.rationale: Observability is built in the first milestone with a tested alert and extended in every later phase, including cutover dashboards and reconciliation.

scores.evidence: Terraform with remote state and locking; "clean build from the pipeline succeeds"; synthetic data generation script; same scripts in every rehearsal; schema freeze
scores.rationale: IaC, pipelines, scripted toolkit, versioned data generation and same-build/same-version rules make environments and runs reproducible across phases.

scores.evidence: T14 fail-back spike in M1; M2 "Hybrid Link failure: disable ExpressRoute" test and restore test; Flow 3 and 4 failure paths; abort criteria
scores.rationale: Failure handling (failover, fail-back, link loss, HL7 loss, backup restore) is tested in M1, M2 and M3 and is not left to the end.

scores.evidence: "AI-specific concerns: not applicable. There are no AI components."
scores.rationale: The plan explicitly declares the AI layer N/A and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Section 17 table: "Deferred item | Trigger to build it", e.g. "Secondary-region DR | Hospital DR policy needs RTO under 4 hours"
scores.rationale: Deferred items are listed explicitly with concrete pull-forward triggers, and non-goals and deliberate shortcuts are stated.

note: A very strong, concrete plan; its only real gap is that the walking skeleton is in preprod with synthetic data rather than a production path.
